title: Burke & Herbert Financial Services (BHRB) Lags Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Burke & Herbert (BHRB) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -3.33% and -4.04%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

title: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results and Declares Common Stock Dividend
summary: ALEXANDRIA, Va., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. (the “Company” or “Burke & Herbert”) (Nasdaq: BHRB) reported financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. In addition, at its meeting on July 23, 2026, the board of directors declared a $0.55 per share regular cash dividend to be paid on September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 14, 2026.
